idea-plugin.name: Svelte Preview
idea-plugin.description:
Preview Svelte 5 components beside your editor. Define named states with typed props, interact with each preview independently, and see changes after saving.

  • Compare loading, empty, error, and populated states together.
  • Use responsive automatic sizing or fixed device viewports, with zoom controls.
  • Mock HTTP requests per state and share styles, setup hooks, and SvelteKit page fixtures.

Requirements

IntelliJ Platform 2026.3 or newer with the JavaScript and TypeScript plugin and JCEF, Svelte 5.46.4 or newer, Node.js 22.12+ on the 22.x line or Node.js 24+, and pnpm to install the runtime.

Setup

  1. Install this IDE plugin.
  2. Install the local runtime as a dev dependency from your Svelte project's package directory: pnpm add -D svelte-preview.
  3. Open a Svelte component and choose View → Tool Windows → Svelte Preview.
  4. Click Create preview, define named states and their props, then save.

Choose a Node.js interpreter under Settings → Tools → Svelte Preview if needed. The preview server runs locally. Configure shared styles and project setup in svelte-preview.config.ts.
